text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back after a day
out with
Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! I completely forgot!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have a test coming up! If I don't do
something,
I'm totally gonna fail!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I need to hurry home and get someone
to tutor
me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aw, and after we had so much fun...
Sorry,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, when I get back to the
academy, I
find Smart Falcon talking to
Eishin Flash in the
central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Really? You're going to a race?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was just leaving. I'm sorry I can't
help you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry for keeping you. Don't
worry about
it, and good luck with the
race!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Good luck studying for your
test.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... If I had just studied when Flash
told me to,
I wouldn't be in this
situation...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh—Trainer! Yeah, pretty much...
choice_data_list: Can't find anyone to teach you?
Can't find anyone to teach you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nobody has time to help me study
today. I'm
doooomed!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?!
choice_data_list: I can teach you, if you'd like.
If you'd like, I can teach you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sooo much! ♪ You're the
most
dependable person on the planet,
Trainer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It should be fine if we just go over what
the test is
going to cover. Or at least
that's what I thought...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Groan... This is all basically gibberish to me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "What part"? Try every part! Urghhhh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at the textbook makes my
head
spin...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh! There's no tiiiime!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hm... If that's your advice, then I'll trust
you!
choice_data_list: Let's take our time and build a solid foundation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not easy, but we take our time
carefully
reviewing past material,
focusing on the
fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer! ☆ I got a much better
grade than
usual! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your teaching style was so thorough and
easy to
understand! Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! ☆ I'll put on a special
performance
just for you to show how
grateful I am! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Check out this brand new song:
"Patient ☆
Perfect ♪ Professor"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my trainer's such a whiz! ♪ Even as a
teacher,
best in the biz! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's from too much studying, but
Smart
Falcon has a strange energy about
her...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But I was just about to steal
your heart
away with the curtain call!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend a lot of time convincing Smart
Falcon to
take it easy for the rest of the
day.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That way, there's less to study!
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna guess my way
through all the
multiple choice
questions! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! It was close, but I passed
the test! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And I owe it all to you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ☆ Thanks a lot! Really! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I just thought of a new song. I'm
calling it
"Tests and Guesswork," and I'm
dedicating it to
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can picture the dance already! For the
"test"
part, I'll hold my head in both
hands in
frustration...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then for the "guesswork" part, I'll just
give a big
ol' shrug, like, "Here goes
nothing!" ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I knowww. But studying's haaard...
choice_data_list: More importantly, you need to study regularly.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Trainer, you're starting to sound like Flash.
